## For a new or changed item

- [ ] It is a yes/no question.
- [ ] It names a test a reviewer can run.
- [ ] It names a primary source, with version or date (not a blog summary).
- [ ] It is labelled correctly where the README uses labels (for example spec requirement versus recommendation).
- [ ] If I could not verify part of it, I added it to "What was not verified" in the README.
- [ ] If I ran a command, the output I describe is real.

## Housekeeping

- [ ] `CHECKLIST.md` matches the README items (same numbers and wording).
- [ ] Links work.
- [ ] No em dashes.
- [ ] "Last verified" date updated if I re-checked sources.
